titles.title: For Your Glory / Send the Winds

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord, if I find favor in Your sight
Lord, please hear my heart's cry

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
I'm desperately waiting
To be where You are
I'll cross the hottest desert
I'll travel near or far

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
For Your glory
I will do anything
Just to see You
To behold You as my King

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Send the winds of refreshing
God, send Your Spirit
Send the winds of refreshing
God, send Your glory down

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
I wanna be where You are
I gotta be where You are
I wanna be where You are
I gotta be where You are

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
For Your name, for Your holy name, O God
Pour Your Spirit among us
For Your name, for Your holy name, O God
Prove Yourself holy among us
